clue.text: Cold display unit for seafood

parts.note: a stand is a unit on which goods are displayed
of can stand for 'for', as in 'a love of music'
fish is food from the sea

explanation.surface: A chilled cabinet in a shop for showing off fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cold' looks like it describes the display unit, but it is the definition, in the sense of an aloof manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone standoffish is distant and unfriendly, a figurative coldness of manner.

clue.text: Bribe succeeded when getting work

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Someone took a bribe and got the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A sop is a small concession given to placate someone, a kind of bribe.

clue.text: Parched, accepting cold bitter

indicators.note: accepting means taking the letter inside

parts.note: arid means parched
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A thirsty drinker welcoming a chilled bitter beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bitter' looks like the beer, but it is the adjective, meaning sharp to taste or smell.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid means pungent and harsh, unpleasantly bitter to taste or smell.

clue.text: A duke abandons debauched attitude for respectful behaviour

indicators.note: abandons means these letters leave the longer word

parts.note: decadency is a decadent, debauched state

explanation.surface: A duke gives up his debauchery for good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Decency is proper, respectable behaviour.

clue.text: Rice's safe served up for stew

indicators.note: served up suggests the letters are dished out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A safe dish served up with rice.
explanation.definitionFit: A fricassee is a dish of meat stewed in a thick white sauce.

clue.text: Bill eventually perhaps becomes attached to popular relative

indicators.note: becomes attached to puts the bill's eventual form after the word for popular

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
a parliamentary bill may eventually become a law

explanation.surface: Bill, a popular relative, finally grows close to the family.
explanation.definitionFit: An in-law is a relative by marriage.

clue.text: One cuts dull writer, as Observer did

parts.note: a hack is an uninspired writer
an observer saw what happened

explanation.surface: A newspaper cuts a dull writer, as the Observer did.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Observer' looks like the newspaper, but it is anyone who observes.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacksaw is a saw for cutting metal, a tool that cuts.

clue.text: An additional problem of consumption

indicators.note: of signals letters taken from within the following word, a piece made of part of it

explanation.surface: A further complication brought on by eating, or by the old lung disease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Consumption' tempts as tuberculosis or eating, but it just holds the answer within its letters. 'Additional' here means to do with addition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum is an arithmetic exercise, a problem in addition set for schoolchildren.

clue.text: What one need not go to great lengths to bake?

definitions.text: What one need not go to great lengths to bake?

parts.words: What one need not go to great lengths to bake?
parts.note: a pun on lengths: a cake that is not long, so needs no great length

explanation.definitionFit: Shortcake is a crumbly biscuit or cake, its name punning on short length.

clue.text: Pretended to convert to Christianity?

definitions.meaning: imaginary or feigned, as in a pretend world
to make someone a believer, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: Make-believe means imagined or feigned, while literally to make believe is to bring to faith.

clue.text: Restricted a legendary creature in glass bottle

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the bottle

parts.note: a phial is a small glass bottle
the roc is a giant mythical bird from the Arabian Nights

explanation.surface: A mythical beast trapped in a glass bottle, like a genie.
explanation.definitionFit: Parochial means narrow and limited in outlook, restricted in scope like a single parish.

clue.text: Watch a person's face

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to ... is to notice or observe

explanation.definitionFit: Clock as slang verb means watch or notice, and as slang noun means the face.

clue.text: Supplements highly irritate mother, front and back being missing

indicators.note: the opening letter and the closing letter of the combined pieces are dropped

parts.note: to madden is to irritate greatly
dam is a mother, especially of an animal

explanation.surface: Extra bits that drive Mum up the wall.
explanation.walkthrough: MADDEN followed by DAM gives MADDENDAM; 'front and back being missing' removes its first and last letters, both M.
explanation.definitionFit: Addenda are additions to a book or document, items that supplement the main text.

clue.text: A Cornishman is strange, old-fashioned chap

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters are in an odd arrangement

explanation.surface: A Cornish fellow is weird and behind the times.
explanation.definitionFit: An anachronism is someone or something out of its own time, as a fusty old-fashioned person can be.

clue.text: Copper lived hard, though got backing

parts.note: was means existed or lived
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: backing means the word for 'though' is read in reverse

parts.note: but can mean though, as in 'poor but honest'

explanation.surface: A policeman who lived a tough life, yet found support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' wants to be a policeman or the metal; here it is the old copper boiler used for washing clothes. BUT reversed gives TUB.
explanation.definitionFit: A copper was a large metal vessel for boiling laundry, a kind of washtub.

clue.text: Community showing a decline over year

indicators.note: over here means turned over, so the word for decline is read backwards

parts.note: to ebb is to decline or recede

explanation.surface: A town in decline over the past twelve months.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' turns the word for decline back to front, giving BBE.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbey is a community of monks or nuns living together.

clue.text: Pretext for initially taking worn bandage

parts.note: a blind is a pretext or cover

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: old means worn

explanation.surface: An excuse for taking a worn bandage.
explanation.definitionFit: A blindfold is a cloth bandage tied over the eyes.

clue.text: Eccentric men seen in singular dance

indicators.note: the men are seen inside the other letters

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
a ball is a formal dance
a crew is a body of men, as on a ship

explanation.surface: Odd men spotted at a one-off dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A screwball is an eccentric or crazy person, from baseball slang.

clue.text: Humect air circulating, causing such aches?

definitions.note: aches of this kind, in the joints and muscles

indicators.note: circulating suggests the letters move around into a new order

explanation.surface: Damp air moving about causes aches and pains.
explanation.walkthrough: HUMECT is an old word meaning to moisten, so the surface is moist air bringing on aches.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheumatic describes aches and pains in the joints, the kind damp weather is blamed for.

clue.text: Using switch, get musical sounding quiet

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical

indicators.note: sounding means the word for quiet is said aloud and written as a word that sounds the same

parts.note: peace means quiet

explanation.surface: Using a switch to get some quiet music.
explanation.walkthrough: A switch is a tress of false hair, not a toggle.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch is a length of false hair worn to add bulk, a type of wig.

clue.text: Visibly astonished pontiff with unknown Eastern daughter

parts.note: the Pope is the pontiff
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: The Pope amazed by an anonymous Eastern girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop-eyed means with eyes bulging, visibly amazed.

clue.text: Topical item: opera house suffers cut-back

indicators.note: cut back means the tail end is cut off

parts.note: the Met is the Metropolitan Opera House in New York

explanation.surface: A news item about a famous opera house making cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme is a topic, a subject under discussion.

clue.text: Storm violently disrupted a party

parts.note: torn means ripped apart violently
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A storm wrecked the party.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: Type of complex dictionary I prize, for the most part

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary

indicators.note: most of the word is used, its last letter dropped

parts.note: the palm is a prize for victory, as in 'bear the palm'

explanation.surface: Winning a dictionary prize for psychological complexity.
explanation.definitionFit: Freud's Oedipus complex gives the adjective describing that type of complex.

clue.text: What leads in lens and surgical eye repairs

definitions.text: What leads in lens and surgical eye repairs

indicators.note: the leads of the words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: The instrument at the forefront of modern eye surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Laser beams are used in surgery to repair the eye, notably in lens and corneal correction.

clue.text: Wonder as vehicle gets back into distance event

indicators.note: into places one piece inside the other

parts.note: the mile is a classic distance race in athletics

indicators.note: back means the vehicle is read backwards

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Amazement as a car turns up in the middle of a long race.
explanation.definitionFit: A miracle is a wonder, something marvellous and inexplicable.

clue.text: Where one regularly unloads junk porcelain?

definitions.meaning: a junk is a Chinese sailing boat, often unloaded in that country

explanation.definitionFit: China is the country of the junk boat and also the name for fine porcelain.

clue.text: What may be carved on either side of trunk

definitions.text: What may be carved on either side of trunk

parts.words: What may be carved on either side of trunk
parts.note: the trunk is an elephant's, flanked by tusks of carvable material

explanation.definitionFit: Ivory comes from elephant tusks, which lie either side of the trunk, and is carved into ornaments.

clue.text: Post hole

definitions.meaning: a post or position of employment
a hole is an awkward predicament

explanation.definitionFit: A situation is a job or position, and also a state of affairs, such as a tight spot.

clue.text: What's lacking when old Penny's left with maiden name

indicators.note: has left means the penny departs from the word

parts.note: a need is something lacking
D was the symbol for an old penny, from Latin denarius

explanation.surface: Penny, short of money, left with only her maiden name.
explanation.definitionFit: Née introduces a married woman's birth surname, her maiden name.

clue.text: Meeting of the Scottish ministry

definitions.meaning: the Gaelic cultural festival held in Scotland

explanation.definitionFit: The Mod is a Scottish Gaelic gathering, and MoD is the Ministry of Defence.

clue.text: Board guide what spokesman does

parts.note: to direct is to guide
a spokesman speaks publicly, that is orates

explanation.surface: A board directs what its spokesman says.
explanation.definitionFit: A directorate is a board of directors.
